card.summary: 5 GB per researcher per year free, then a one-off €4.50/GB (~$4,900/TB). Some sources cite 10 GB for non-4TU institutions.

record.limits_note: Strict quota enforced with paid per-gigabyte pricing.

identity_cost.detail: Email. Explicitly open: 'Anyone from science, engineering and design can use 4TU.ResearchData to upload and publish their research data and software' and 'I am not affiliated with one of the 4TU's, can I deposit my data? Anyone .. can upload'. The identity gate is genuinely zero; the quota gate is what kills it.

record.reliability_note: Pricing is per-GB one-off, so cost scales linearly with volume. No bulk escape.
